Switching out of S mode in Windows 11
 Windows 11 in S mode is designed for security and performance, exclusively running apps from the Microsoft Store. If you want to install an app that isn't available in the Microsoft Store, you'll need to switch out of S mode
1. On your PC running Windows 11 in S mode, open Settings > System > Activation.

2. In the Switch to Windows 11 Pro section, select Go to the Store. (If you also see an "Upgrade your edition of Windows" section, be careful not to click the "Go to the Store" link that appears there.)

3. On the Switch out of S mode (or similar) page that appears in the Microsoft Store, select the Get button. After you see a confirmation message on the page, you'll be able to install apps from outside of the Microsoft Store.

【Crisp 2K IPS Touchscreen】Enjoy stunning detail and wide viewing angles on the 15.6" 2K IPS touchscreen. This FHD Laptop's display is perfect for professionals reviewing financial models or students working on intricate graphic design assignments.

【32GB RAM for Seamless Workflows】Multitask efficiently with 32GB of DDR4 system memory. This Dell computer notebook provides the necessary headroom for running virtual machines, editing large spreadsheets, or having numerous research papers open simultaneously.

【Spacious & Speedy 1TB SSD】Benefit from rapid file access and generous storage with a 1TB SSD. This Dell Laptop allows business users to store extensive client portfolios and students to keep all their term projects in one secure place.

【Windows 11 Pro for Business & Study】Work with confidence on Windows 11 Pro, offering robust security and productivity tools. This makes the Dell Touchscreen Laptop a dependable choice for professionals handling sensitive data and students needing a stable platform.

【Next-Gen Wi-Fi 6 for Uninterrupted Work】Enjoy lag-free connectivity with Wi-Fi 6. Whether you're a gaming user in a competitive match or a professional in a crucial video call, this Dell notebook ensures a stable and fast connection.

【Comprehensive Connectivity Hub】Expand your workspace effortlessly with multiple USB ports and an HDMI output. This Dell 15.6" 2K Laptop serves as a central hub for presentations, external drives, and peripherals in any office or dorm room.

【Highly Portable 4.28lb Chassis】Carry your powerful workstation anywhere. The slim and lightweight laptop design is ideal for commuting professionals and college students moving between lectures, the library, and study groups.

【HD Webcam for Professional Presence】Make a great impression in every virtual interaction with the integrated 720p camera. This Dell Business Laptop ensures you are seen clearly during remote internships, online seminars, or client check-ins.

【Efficient 65W Fast Charging】Spend less time plugged in. The efficient 65W fast charger quickly powers up this Dell Touchscreen Laptop Computer, minimizing downtime and keeping you productive during long flights or all-day campus events.
